text:
Taylor Nguyen: Quick pulse  DP funnel conversion is low after last outreach. 80 invites, 6 activated. Need triage.
Lee Kim: Saw that. Two patterns: asks for billing info too early, and the onboarding script references an internal CLI command that no longer exists.
Priyanka Rao: Also some partners reported the NDA link opened a stale Google doc with comment mode on. That made them pause.
Marco Silva: Email invites blocked for a few corporate MXes; logs show `INVITE_DELIVER_FAIL`. I'll add an alternate signed token link and fallback SMTP sender.
Taylor Nguyen: Can we split into 'trial-lite' vs 'design-track'? Trial-lite = 1-click, no billing, simple quickstart. Design-track = commitment + NDA + scheduled check-ins.
Lee Kim: For design-track acceptance criteria draft:
- commit to 3 x 30-min feedback sessions across 21 days
- provide 2 representative prompt templates and expected outputs
- sign NDA + accept redacted logs policy
Priyanka Rao: Rephrase feedback asks as specific tasks: "rate output accuracy on two use-cases", "submit any failing input/response pairs", "verify latency under heavy load". Makes sessions actionable.
Marco Silva: I'll roll out email fallback and update invite tokens by EOD. Test cohort `dp-triage-2025-06-10`.
DevOpsBot: deploy: onboarding-site v1.14 promoted to staging at 2025-06-10T11:02Z
Taylor Nguyen: Also remove billing and org-size from initial form. Make them optional in a follow-up survey after activation.
Lee Kim: I'll patch the quickstart to remove stale CLI references and snap new screenshots. PR `docs/onboard#204`.
Priyanka Rao: I'll replace the NDA link with a self-hosted PDF and short summary bullets in the invite so recipients know what they'll sign.
Taylor Nguyen: A/B plan: baseline invite vs condensed invite + $250 credits + early-feature opt-in. 2 cohorts of 75 each. KPI: week-1 activation.
Marco Silva: Logging failing domains to INF-430: corpsecure.io, biz-global.net. Sample log: `2025-06-10T10:47Z INVITE_DELIVER_FAIL corpsecure.io`
Lee Kim: Add a simple checklist in the invite: "What we need from you" with 3 bullets so DP expectations are clear.
Priyanka Rao: Good idea. I'll draft the invite copy and session templates and post before the 16:00 sync.
Taylor Nguyen: Scheduling 30m sync 16:00 PT today. Agenda: invite copy, fallback flow, acceptance criteria, A/B setup. Bring any telemetry you have.
DevOpsBot: calendar: DP funnel triage 16:00 PT today  attendees: Taylor, Lee, Priyanka, Marco
Marco Silva: Will paste initial open/click numbers before the sync.
Taylor Nguyen: Target: lift trial activation from ~7% -> 30% for the trial-lite cohort. Small rapid experiments only.
Lee Kim: Putting task list in tracker: remove fields, fix screenshots, swap NDA link, add checklist, add fallback.
Priyanka Rao: Adding success metrics: activation %, onboarding completion, feedback adherence %, week-2 CSAT.
Marco Silva: Running quick test `dp-triage-2025-06-10` and will report results here.
Taylor Nguyen: Thanks all. Ping if you hit blockers.
